selection_rule: Eligible paired cases require standalone forward-Train-validation HOTA gain >=0.1 and complete full-Dev HOTA >= prior52.11311409153856 minus1e-10. Rank by standalone validation HOTA, then Dev HOTA, AssA, IDF1 descending, then id. Exact Dev ties are allowed prospectively. Count/RGB/duplicated/unconditional are controls and cannot be promoted from Test.

independent_audit.scope: Raw official47/39, MOT validity and hashes, unchanged parent references, Train/Dev gate activation from prior scalar bank, source/actual exits and prospective selection; not a second visual producer, independent Kalman/LAP replay or end-to-end runtime test.

Train_failure_geometry.selection: Worst standalone-validation per-sequence HOTA delta for paired0.25, then first3 original full-Train gated frames; never a Test sequence or inference rule
Train_failure_geometry.interpretation: Geometric overlap can test duplicate or merged-object explanations; it does not by itself prove the cause of identity degradation.

runtime_scope: Cached CPU replay and official evaluation only; excludes original image IO, neural inference and fixed IR generation. No new end-to-end FPS claim.
